facts.fact: President Lourenço says programmes such as N'gola Digital, Escola Conectada and Conecta Angola brought connectivity to communities including remote areas via ANGOSAT-2, and that strengthening connectivity in rural communities is a priority for coming years.

ANGOP reports that ANGOSAT-2, a government space programme project, has let operators install more than 150 VSAT terminals in remote localities across 16 of 18 provinces, and that the government's Conecta Angola platform was launched in June 2023 to extend internet to unserved zones.

MINTTICS says its Conecta Angola project, launched in June 2023 to bring voice and internet to remote areas operators do not serve, has reached more than 300,000 people previously without communications, per GGPEN director-general Zolana João.

Portal de T.I. reports President Lourenco authorised US$50 million in Despacho 394/26 of 20 October 2026 and a public tender for the Programa Conectividade, extending broadband to less-served areas with schools and community centres first, under the World Bank-financed PADA.

The record says Presidential Despacho 394/26 of 20 October 2026 authorised US$50 million for the Programa Conectividade to extend broadband to underserved areas, inside the World Bank-financed Angola Digital Acceleration Project, with every project indicator for people reaching broadband still at 0 as at 30 April 2026.

facts.fact: Minister Mario Oliveira says ANGOSAT-2 has expanded connectivity to underserved communities including schools and hospitals, and the Conecta Angola Programme involves 71 small ISPs.

Angola's communications minister said the Iluminar Angola Project, on national roaming and infrastructure sharing, is being implemented to reach more than one million citizens in 70 localities by 2027.

Minister Mário Oliveira said the satellite project Conecta Angola covers about 120 localities, mainly areas not served by mobile operators, and Ilumina Angola creates conditions for operators to serve localities where private investment is less viable.
